subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should a durable wake become terminally `delivered` when the internal session queue accepts it, and may that queued system event cross a session reset?
rationale: The patch deliberately defines delivery as persisted queue ownership transfer rather than session consumption, while current reset behavior protects new session generations from prior queued context; code review cannot choose that durable product contract safely.

options.title: Approve fenced queue handoff
options.body: Treat durable delivery as complete at durable enqueue, but require the event to be skipped after a session-generation change and keep terminal queue failures independently inspectable.

options.title: Wait for queue consumption
options.body: Keep or reconcile the durable wake as unresolved until the session queue acknowledges consumption or records permanent failure.

options.title: Pause the final stack item
options.body: Defer the handoff until the predecessor stack lands and the durable delivery-state model is reconsidered as a separate change.

recommendation.title: Approve fenced queue handoff
recommendation.body: Treat durable delivery as complete at durable enqueue, but require the event to be skipped after a session-generation change and keep terminal queue failures independently inspectable.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current queue and recovery semantics that define the receiving side of this ownership transfer.
